title: Source-owned classification: a distinct premise, but no new P0 wordbook test
scope: Producer review of existing primaries only. No native or source extraction, counting, image, table construction, encoder, new acquisition or experiment. Root proposed the classification question during this review; it is not an independent discovery.
decision: Do not count category adjacency or construct a taxonomic carrier for the unchanged1176P0 projection. A different source-owned semantic classification has not been shown identical to the old synthetic families, but it leaves the decisive word-frequency invariant unchanged. Pure synonym merging also cannot repair the concentration bound.

predecessor_distinctions.finding: The old hierarchy writer emits seven separate role/value words. Its plant, part and state dimensions are finite taught fields, not a source-owned semantic taxonomy of an ordinary full text. REPORT.md gives the specific six-of-seven small-field concentration obstruction. Preserve that failure without treating it as a universal taxonomy theorem.
The384frequent source-form IDs are explicitly not semantic concepts; their frequency-rank order is fixed.172 changes the rare literal mechanism, not those identities.

The irregular32families and24construction variants walk the already frozen lexical-ID order. This is a paid reversible synthetic table and an instrument control, not independent historical classification. Its complete-family construction is a relevant cost predecessor, not proof that source-owned categories were tested.

The low-capacity latent renderer-class transfer failed. Its declared endpoint is opaque renderer classes, explicitly not lexical class or meaning.288's proposed low-complexity cross-host rule also receives the negative289/290followups; no old proposed next step is revived.

This existing raw concerns one-parent property inheritance with explicit override. It does not supply a whole-text writer, taxonomic spelling rule or independent parent/property binding. Retain its imported unreviewed status; do not add a duplicate or select another unchanged missing-binding audit.

The already viewed glossary supplies an actual limited shared piece with independently glossed kinship contrasts and an adjacent irregular whole. It remains useful positive historical source evidence. It does not supply full prose syntax or a full taxonomic encoder, and no new inspection was made.
